steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings are the same on every point I could check.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

Nothing on these pages favours one seller over the other. Both show the same 4.3 rating from 210 reviews. That may be the product's overall rating and not a rating of the seller, so it doesn't tell you which seller is more reliable.

Some things could still matter, and the listings don't cover them:
- **Seller reputation:** Look for independent reviews of Ottervale Audio and Brackmoor Sound, such as their ratings, complaint history and how they handle returns.
- **Authenticity:** Both say "sold and shipped by" the seller. Neither page says the headphones are new, genuine or authorized-reseller stock.
- **Price at checkout:** Check for taxes or fees that differ between the two before you pay.

If those checks turn up nothing, pick whichever seller you trust more, or just choose one. You'd get the same product, price, shipping and protections either way.
